LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text, keyed by locale. Realmforge ships English only, so en_us is the one locale.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

description: A simple full block that drops itself, with its block item.

blast_resistance.description: How well the block withstands explosions: stone 6, obsidian 1200.
blast_resistance.title: Blast Resistance

creative_tabs.description: Creative mode tabs to list the block's item in, e.g. minecraft:natural_blocks. No duplicates.

items.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

creative_tabs.title: Creative Tabs

hardness.description: How long the block takes to mine: stone 1.5, deepslate 3, obsidian 50.
hardness.title: Hardness

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

requires_tool.description: Drops nothing unless mined with the right tool, as stone needs a pickaxe. Needs a tool.
requires_tool.title: Requires Tool

sound.description: What breaking, placing and walking on it sound like.
sound.title: Sound

tool.description: The tool that mines it at full speed (minecraft:mineable/<tool>); none: by hand.
tool.title: Tool

tool_tier.description: Optional: the lowest tier of that tool that gets the drops (minecraft:needs_<tier>_tool).
tool_tier.title: Tool Tier
